mission: Provide one owner control that runs the broadest safe repository verification, recovery, benchmarks, sandbox, ontology, workforce, gap, runtime, speed, accuracy, business/public-sector/creative value and certification systems and records every failure for repair.

always_on_model.meaning: durable supervised recurring execution rather than one immortal process

benchmark_gap_rule: Every generated benchmark case is scanned into the parallel benchmark gap registry and receives accountable benchmark, builder, integration, QA, security/compliance, performance, business-value and release-review lanes.
government_rule: Government benchmarks must improve usability, productivity, transparency and service quality one department/service/job/task at a time, preserve jurisdiction-specific authority, and require authoritative current sources for programs, forms, fees, eligibility, spending, debt, grants and contracts.
max_sandbox_rule: Every bot capability, discovered tool/function, generated worker, API, resource, job task, business workflow and deployment path maps to all applicable sandbox categories including negative, property/metamorphic/fuzz, adversarial, security, permission, privacy, recovery, fault/chaos, load, migration, compatibility, accessibility, speed, accuracy, cost, observability and rollback overlays.
live_user_gate: Run Everything Now may certify readiness for controlled live-user testing only when release blockers are zero, core production verification passes, required sandbox coverage has runtime evidence, high-risk actions remain approval gated, and observability/rollback are ready.
truth_rule: Running everything creates evidence; it does not make failing or untested systems pass. Always-on operation means supervised recurring/restartable execution with explicit cost and safety controls.
